## Description

Trade potential reversal when close is near the recent high/low range extremes.

## Where it may fit

Oscillating markets with relatively stable ranges.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, FX, futures and crypto.

## Required data

OHLC prices over the lookback; liquidity and costs.

## Caveats

Extreme readings are not stand-alone reversal forecasts.
